description: BAL-05/06 in the interface layer: quest goal fights spawn at most Battle.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES enemies in solo quests at every level (was levels 1-14 only), and every goal fight records packSize (the size of a full goal fight) so the group power budget treats the last, smaller goal fight as weaker instead of scaling it up.

edits.name: Solo goal cap at every level and full goal-fight size
edits.new: cap=e0&&e0.size===1&&B.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES?B.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES:3;if(e0)e0.packSize=Math.min(cap,q.goals.reduce(function(s,g){return s+g.count;},0));/* BAL-05: лимит одиночного боя на всех уровнях; BAL-06: размер полного боя за целями для бюджета группового задания */
